title: Learning to Discover at Test Time
authors_zh: Mert Yuksekgonul、Daniel Koceja、James Zou、Carlos Guestrin、Yu Sun（斯坦福大学）；Xinhao Li、Xiaolong Wang（加州大学圣地亚哥分校）；Federico Bianchi、James Zou（Together AI）；Jed McCaleb（Astera Institute）；Jan Kautz、Yejin Choi、Yu Sun（NVIDIA）
paper_type_zh: 测试时强化学习与科学发现研究
best_for_zh: 研究测试时计算是否可包含参数更新和问题特定优化的读者。
one_line: TTT-Discover uses problem-specific test-time reinforcement learning to search for one high-reward scientific or engineering solution rather than merely sample from a frozen model.
TTT-Discover 在测试时针对当前问题继续强化学习，以连续奖励搜索一个最优科学或工程解，而非只从冻结模型采样。
why: It expands the test-time scaling boundary from inference over frozen parameters to targeted optimization on the active problem.
inclusion_reason: It scales inference by performing reinforcement learning on a single test problem, making test-time compute an explicit problem-specific optimization budget.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time scaling holds model parameters fixed and spends more computation on prompting, sampling, or search. That is often inadequate for a scientific or engineering problem where the objective is one exceptional solution, the reward is continuous, and the useful experience is specific to the current instance rather than transferable across a benchmark distribution.

TTT-Discover asks whether a model can keep learning at test time for the active problem. It treats each problem as its own optimization environment and allocates compute to generate candidates, receive task reward, update the policy, and focus future search on the most promising solutions.

多数测试时扩展固定模型参数，只把更多计算花在提示、采样或搜索上。对于科学或工程问题，这往往不够：目标是一个出色解，奖励是连续的，有用经验又只针对当前实例，而非能在整个基准分布中迁移。

TTT-Discover 研究模型能否在测试时继续为当前问题学习。它把每个问题视为独立优化环境，把计算分配给生成候选、接收任务奖励、更新策略，并让后续搜索聚焦最有希望的解。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The method shifts the test-time consumer from a frozen decoder to a problem-specific reinforcement-learning loop. It uses experience generated while solving one target to update the model toward higher continuous reward on that target. The intended outcome is not average performance across many inputs but the best solution found for the one active mathematical, algorithmic, kernel, or biology problem.

This makes test-time compute include learning. Search and optimization are designed to prioritize promising solutions, and reported results are reviewed by task experts or organizers. The resulting record contains more than a chain of thought: it contains a sequence of candidate solutions, reward outcomes, updates, and the best solution selected after problem-specific adaptation.

该方法把测试时消费者从冻结解码器转为问题特定的强化学习循环。它利用解决一个目标问题时产生的经验，更新模型以提高该目标上的连续奖励。预期结果不是许多输入上的平均性能，而是为当前数学、算法、内核或生物问题找到的最佳解。

这使测试时计算包含学习。搜索和优化被设计为优先处理有希望的解，所报告结果由任务专家或组织者审阅。由此产生的记录不止思维链，还包括候选解、奖励结果、更新和问题特定适应后选出的最佳解。

title: Method
方法
html:
TTT-Discover starts from the open gpt-oss-120b model and uses the Tinker API to run reinforcement learning during solution of a single problem. Candidate programs or solutions are evaluated by the task’s continuous reward, and the policy/search procedure is updated to favor promising regions. This is repeated within the test-time budget until the system returns its best discovered solution.

The evaluation spans Erdos-type mathematics, GPU kernel engineering, past AtCoder competitions, and single-cell denoising. The official project reports results for every attempted problem, provides code and verification links, and states that test-time training costs a few hundred dollars per problem. The method should therefore be evaluated by solution quality and total per-problem optimization cost, not by ordinary fixed-model latency alone.

TTT-Discover 从开放的 gpt-oss-120b 出发，使用 Tinker API 在解决单个问题期间运行强化学习。候选程序或解由任务连续奖励评估，策略和搜索流程随之更新以偏向有希望区域。该过程在测试时预算内重复，直到系统返回发现的最佳解。

评测覆盖 Erdős 类数学、GPU 内核工程、过往 AtCoder 竞赛和单细胞去噪。官方项目报告每个尝试问题的结果，提供代码和验证链接，并称每题测试时训练花费数百美元。因此应按解质量和每题总优化成本评估，而非只按普通冻结模型延迟评估。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The project reports new or improved results across all attempted domains. Examples include up to twofold faster GPU kernels than prior art, better results on selected AtCoder heuristic contests, and denoising scores of 0.71 and 0.73 on the listed PBMC and Tabula tasks versus a 0.64 best-human reference. The paper states that mathematical and algorithmic solutions were reviewed by experts or competition organizers.

This evidence supports problem-specific discovery under continuous reward, not broad zero-shot generalization. The stated cost is only a few hundred dollars per problem, but that is still far larger than ordinary one-shot inference. A careful comparison must retain the reward evaluator, expert-review process, number of updates, and full task budget alongside the final headline solution.

项目报告所有尝试领域的新或改进结果，包括相对先前工作最高两倍更快的 GPU 内核、部分 AtCoder 启发式竞赛的更好结果，以及所列 PBMC 和 Tabula 任务上分别为 0.71 和 0.73 的去噪分数，相对最佳人类参考 0.64。论文称数学和算法解由专家或竞赛组织者审阅。

这些证据支持连续奖励下的问题特定发现，而非广泛零样本泛化。所述成本每题仅数百美元，但仍远高于普通一次推理。严谨比较必须把奖励评估器、专家审阅过程、更新次数和完整任务预算与最终标题解一起保留。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Conventional test-time scaling searches with a frozen model. TTT-Discover changes the optimization boundary by updating the model from reward experience during the active task. This is not generic fine-tuning for later users: the learned state is deliberately optimized to solve one problem and may be discarded afterward.

The distinctive decision object is the problem-specific training trajectory. It includes which variants to generate, which rewards to trust, which updates to take, and when to stop. Before reuse, readers should examine whether the reward measures the real scientific objective, whether test-time updates exploit benchmark artifacts, and whether expert review validates the claimed solution beyond the optimization metric.

常规测试时扩展用冻结模型搜索。TTT-Discover 通过在当前任务中从奖励经验更新模型，改变了优化边界。这不是为后续用户进行通用微调：学习状态被刻意优化来解决一个问题，之后可以丢弃。

独特决策对象是问题特定训练轨迹，其中包含生成哪些变体、信任哪些奖励、采取哪些更新以及何时停止。复用前，读者应检查奖励是否衡量真实科学目标、测试时更新是否利用基准伪影，以及专家审阅能否在优化指标之外验证所声称的解。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach needs a continuous, inexpensive-enough, and trustworthy reward for the individual problem; many natural-language tasks lack such a signal. Per-problem learning costs more than ordinary inference and can overfit to the evaluator or discover metric-specific shortcuts. Expert or organizer review is valuable but may differ across domains. Reproduction also depends on the Tinker service and the exact optimization configuration, so cost, access, and update stability must be audited before treating the results as a general-purpose inference recipe.
该方法需要针对单个问题连续、足够廉价且可信的奖励；许多自然语言任务没有这种信号。每题学习比普通推理成本更高，也可能过拟合评估器或发现指标特定捷径。专家或组织者审阅很有价值，但各领域标准可能不同。复现还依赖 Tinker 服务和确切优化配置，因此在把结果视为通用推理配方前，必须审计成本、访问条件和更新稳定性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper for scientific or engineering tasks where one strong solution matters more than average benchmark accuracy and where an executable or continuous reward exists. The operating log should include all generated candidates, reward calls, policy updates, dollar cost, and independent validation. It is a useful boundary case for test-time scaling: if the active task can safely provide learning feedback, compute can be spent on adaptation rather than only on wider sampling.
当科学或工程任务中一个强解比平均基准准确率更重要，且存在可执行或连续奖励时，可使用本文。运行日志应包含所有候选、奖励调用、策略更新、美元成本和独立验证。它是测试时扩展的有用边界案例：若当前任务能安全提供学习反馈，计算可花在适应上，而不只是更宽的采样。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: TTT-Discover scales through learning, not merely deliberation. It optimizes for one current problem under continuous reward, so its cost and evaluation protocol are inseparable from the claimed result. The official project is important because it exposes code and verification links. Keep its ICML 2026 Spotlight status, open-model backbone, per-problem dollar budget, and expert-review boundary visible when comparing it with ordinary Best-of-N or verifier reranking.
TTT-Discover 通过学习而非仅思考进行扩展。它在连续奖励下为一个当前问题优化，因此成本和评测协议与所声称结果不可分割。官方项目很重要，因为它公开代码和验证链接。把它与普通 Best-of-N 或验证器重排序比较时，应保持 ICML 2026 Spotlight 身份、开放模型骨干、每题美元预算和专家审阅边界可见。
